reviewItem.question: For "The previously deprecated built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been removed", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The deprecated Helm value wireguard.userspaceFallback (built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback) has been removed; WireGuard transparent encryption now requires a Linux kernel with WireGuard support.
